title: Lost City
start: Talk to the warrior adventurer north-west of Lumbridge Swamp.

recommended.t: Items to create combat equipment on Entrana (see #ifeq: SUBPAGENAME | Quick guide | the full guide | below )
Food and prayer potions for low level players

kills.t: The tree spirit must be killed without the use of weapons that cannot be smuggled onto Entrana, though some weapons and armour can be crafted or a hatchet may be removed from the toolbelt:

rewards.t: Ability to wield dragon longswords and dragon daggers
Ability to make cosmic runes with the Runecrafting skill
Ability to use Chaeldar as slayer master (requires level 75 combat)

steps.t: Talk to the Warrior northwest of the Lumbridge swamp to start the quest. [Chat: 1 Why are you camped out here? › 1 Who's Zanaris? › 1 If it's hidden, how are you planning to find it? › 2 Looks like you don't know either. › Accept]
Attempt to chop the swamp tree south of the campsite - There will be an option to "chop" tree instead of "chop down" tree, and a quest icon on the tooltip.
Talk to Shamus. [Chat: 2 I've been in that shed and I didn't see a city. › 1 Yes, please, a teleport would be useful.]

Bring items to craft a weapon on Entrana. If you plan on using magic, you must have a magic weapon; you cannot cast spells without one. You can also remove tool belt items once you enter the dungeon, e.g. a mithril hatchet, for use in combat.
p: A safespot to fight the tree spirit from by standing behind the fungus south of the tree.

steps.t: Talk to the monks on the northern pier of Port Sarim to be transported to Entrana.
Do not craft your weapons now or you'll be thrown out of Entrana.
Run north-west though the wooded area to the dungeon entrance ladder.
p: A melee safespot to fight the tree spirit from. Stand near the torch then run around to setup.

steps.t: Enter the dungeon. [Chat: 2 Well, that is a risk I will have to take.]
Run to the southern-most part of the dungeon.

sub.t: Make sure to let the dialogue appear before chopping again, or you may spawn a second spirit.

steps.t: Craft the dramen branch using a knife.

sub.t: If you have not completed the quest Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Sir Amik Varze yet, you may want to get a second dramen branch and craft it with the pestle and mortar. This gives an item required for the quest, cinnamon, and saves an otherwise necessary second trip to the island.

steps.t: Enter the door to the east or teleport out.
Enter the shed in the centre of the Lumbridge swamp (south-east of the quest start).
